In this role, you will lead the outbound effort to modernize how Brazilian companies handle corporate spending and payables. You will identify and convert high-potential prospects that currently rely on legacy banking, manual AP processes, or fragmented financial tools. This is a hunter position: you will own the full sales cycle, from initial prospecting to contract signing, navigating the specific complexities of the Brazilian financial ecosystem to deliver Clara's integrated solution. You will: Drive the outbound sales motion for Clara's accounts payable module and related financial workflow solutions. Lead the go-to-market strategy for accounts payable and financial automation across target industries. Identify and engage companies using legacy or manual financial processes, positioning Clara as the integrated alternative to traditional banks, point solutions, and manual expense tools. Generate a high volume of qualified leads through proactive prospecting and strategic outreach via Amplemarket. Manage a robust pipeline of mid-market and enterprise clients, focusing on long-term scalability. Influence Finance Directors, CFOs, and Controllers by demonstrating a deep understanding of financial workflows, reconciliation, and ERP integration. Consistently exceed monthly and quarterly sales targets and deal-volume KPIs. Maintain meticulous records of all sales activity and client interactions using Hubspot. Use Google Drive and Slack to collaborate internally and ensure seamless handoffs to the implementation team. Act as a brand ambassador, clearly communicating Clara's differentiation within the Brazilian accounts payable and financial automation landscape. Who you are "We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement." Must haves: Deep expertise in accounts payable workflows, with proven experience selling, implementing, or negotiating solutions related to payments, ERP integrations, financial automation, approval flows, reconciliation, and cash management. Minimum 5 years of experience in outbound sales of accounts payable, financial automation, or finance-focused B2B SaaS solutions — whether at a Fintech, a Corporate Bank, an Expense Management company, or a specialized financial automation/AP software provider (e.g., Kamino-type players). What matters is proven success selling this type of solution, not the specific industry label of your former employer. Deep practical knowledge of the Brazilian financial market, including corporate credit, payment processing, or ERP-adjacent SaaS. Strong "hunter" profile with a track record of managing high-activity outbound cycles and complex negotiations. Proven experience selling to financial personas (CFOs, Treasurers, Controllers) and understanding their specific pain points. Working proficiency in Portuguese and intermediate proficiency in English (capable of reading documentation and participating in internal syncs). Experience or interest in AI tools to automate prospecting and increase outreach efficiency. Excellent verbal and written communication and negotiation skills. Adaptability to fast-changing environments. Availability to work from our office in Itaim Bibi (São Paulo) at least 2x per week. Nice to haves: Previous experience in high-growth companies within the financial services, financial automation, or benefits landscape. Established network of finance leaders and decision-makers in the Brazilian market. Independent analytical skills using spreadsheets, SQL, or Metabase. Passionate about making Latin America more prosperous and competitive. Constantly innovating to build financial infrastructure that enables each of our customers to thrive. Product-led, high-talent-density culture — designed for builders who raise the bar. Proud of our open, inclusive, and values-driven environment. What we believe in #Clarity. We say things clearly, directly, and proactively. #Simplicity. We reduce noise to focus on what really matters. #Ownership. We take responsibility and never wait to be told. #Pride. We build products and experiences we’re proud of. #Always Be Changing (ABC). We grow through feedback, risk-taking, and action. #Inclusivity. Every voice counts. Everyone contributes to our mission. Se você é o tipo de pessoa que prototipa antes de apresentar, lança antes de pedir permissão e conquista confiança por estar perto do trabalho, você vai se encaixar aqui. O que é um Product Lead? Um Product Lead é responsável pela direção de produto de um squad pequeno e autônomo. Você decide o que construir, por que isso importa e se funcionou. Você é responsável pelos resultados de negócio, não apenas pelas funcionalidades entregues. O que diferencia esse papel de um Product Manager tradicional? Você não escreve especificações e as passa adiante. Você prototipa ideias com ferramentas de IA antes de comprometer tempo de engenharia. You will own the full credit lifecycle from a product perspective—balancing high-velocity execution with strict risk mitigation. Your primary responsibilities will include: Owning the entire Risk product surface across both Acquisition and Portfolio Management, including onboarding risk checks, credit line increases/decreases, and internal tools for the Fraud Risk Operations team. Managing the integration layer with critical Credit and Fraud Risk vendors (Decisioning Engines, Credit Bureaus, SIFT, and ID Validation Vendors), mapping gaps, and making high-impact build vs. buy decisions. Translating complex risk model outputs into seamless product experiences by collaborating closely with Data Science and Credit Risk teams to design around model uncertainty. Defining and tracking core business metrics , including approval rates, fraud loss rates, credit utilization, credit line adjustment accuracy, and time-to-decision. Accelerating product delivery by writing clear PRDs, managing the product backlog, and driving cross-team alignment without relying on unnecessary meetings. Building no-code/low-code solutions and automating workflows using tools like N8N or Oscilar. Embracing a builder mindset by leveraging AI tools like Cursor, Claude Code, or v0 to prototype concepts, making straightforward code or configuration changes, and self-serving your own analytics dashboards. Product experience within LatAm fintech markets, specifically dealing with credit products in Mexico, Colombia, or Brazil.
